desc: Implement input reading and basic validation.
Build the character mapping from S to T and check for consistency (each char in S maps to exactly one char in T) and injectivity (no two chars in S map to the same char in T).
Construct the functional graph from the mapping.
Detect if there are any cycles in the graph.
Count the number of non-self-loop edges (K).
If cycles exist, check if all 26 letters are present in S. If so, return -1. Otherwise, return K + 1.
